WITH m AS (
  SELECT zoneref,
    (mesh_specs->>'Facet_Faces')::numeric / ((mesh_specs->>'Facet_Verts')::numeric * power((mesh_specs->>'Facet_Res_Mm')::numeric, 2)) * 1000 AS mcr,
    (mesh_specs->>'Facet_Res_Mm')::numeric AS res,
    (mesh_specs->>'Geom_Delta_Mm')::numeric AS geom
  FROM mesh
), agg AS (
  SELECT si.zoneregistry, si.zonelabel,
    COUNT(m.zoneref) AS total_meshes,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE m.mcr > 5.0 AND m.res < 1.0 AND m.geom < 0.5) AS hf_meshes,
    AVG(m.mcr) AS avg_mcr, AVG(m.res) AS avg_res, AVG(m.geom) AS avg_geom
  FROM sites si LEFT JOIN m ON m.zoneref = si.zoneregistry
  GROUP BY si.zoneregistry, si.zonelabel
)
SELECT zoneregistry AS site_code, zonelabel AS site_name, total_meshes, hf_meshes,
  ROUND(CASE WHEN total_meshes > 0 THEN hf_meshes * 100.0 / total_meshes ELSE 0 END, 2) AS hf_percentage,
  ROUND(avg_mcr, 2) AS avg_mcr, ROUND(avg_res, 2) AS avg_resolution_mm, ROUND(avg_geom, 2) AS avg_geometric_accuracy_mm,
  CASE WHEN hf_meshes > 0 THEN 'Has High-Fidelity Meshes'
       WHEN total_meshes > 0 THEN 'Standard Mesh Quality'
       ELSE 'No Mesh Data' END AS mesh_quality_classification
FROM agg
ORDER BY hf_percentage DESC

WITH r AS (
  SELECT reg.logregistry, reg.arcref,
    (reg.reg_accuracy->>'Log_Accu_Mm')::numeric AS acc,
    (reg.reg_accuracy->>'Err_Val_Mm')::numeric AS err,
    reg.reg_accuracy->>'Log_Method' AS method,
    (p.cloud_metrics->>'Scan_Resol_Mm')::numeric AS res
  FROM registration reg
  JOIN pointcloud p ON p.arcref = reg.arcref AND p.crewref = reg.crewref
), x AS (
  SELECT *, res / (acc * sqrt(1 + err/acc)) AS rar FROM r
)
SELECT logregistry AS registration_id, arcref AS project_id, acc AS registration_accuracy_mm, err AS error_value_mm,
  ROUND(rar, 2) AS rar,
  CASE WHEN rar > 1.5 AND method LIKE '%Target%' THEN 'High Confidence'
       WHEN rar BETWEEN 1.0 AND 1.5 THEN 'Medium Confidence'
       ELSE 'Low Confidence' END AS confidence_level
FROM x
ORDER BY rar DESC

WITH e AS (
  SELECT zoneref,
    100 - 2.5 * abs((ambient_cond->>'Ambic_Temp')::numeric - 20)
        - power(abs(((ambient_cond->>'Hume_Pct')::numeric - 50) / 2), 1.5)
        - 600 / ((ambient_cond->>'Illume_Lux')::numeric + 100) AS esi
  FROM environment
)
SELECT si.zoneregistry AS site_code, si.zonelabel AS site_name, ROUND(AVG(e.esi), 2) AS avg_esi
FROM e JOIN sites si ON si.zoneregistry = e.zoneref
GROUP BY si.zoneregistry, si.zonelabel
ORDER BY avg_esi DESC

SELECT si.zoneregistry AS site_code, si.zonelabel AS site_name, c.structstate AS structural_state,
  si.site_status->>'Pres_Stat' AS preservation_status,
  CASE WHEN (si.site_status->>'Pres_Stat' LIKE '%Poor%' OR si.site_status->>'Pres_Stat' LIKE '%Critical%')
        AND c.structstate NOT LIKE '%Stable%' THEN 'Degradation Risk Zone'
       ELSE 'Not in Risk Zone' END AS risk_zone_category
FROM sites si JOIN conservation c ON c.zoneref = si.zoneregistry
note: Lists every site with a conservation record and its category (the category column only makes sense if non-risk sites appear). Structural state comes from conservation.structstate; the test is case-sensitive, so Unstable does not count as Stable.

WITH base AS (
  SELECT s.zoneref,
    (p.cloud_metrics->>'Scan_Resol_Mm')::numeric AS res,
    (p.cloud_metrics->>'Point_Dense')::numeric AS pd,
    (p.cloud_metrics->>'Cover_Pct')::numeric AS cov,
    (p.cloud_metrics->>'Lap_Pct')::numeric AS lap,
    (p.cloud_metrics->>'Noise_Db')::numeric AS noise,
    (r.reg_accuracy->>'Log_Accu_Mm')::numeric AS acc,
    (r.reg_accuracy->>'Err_Val_Mm')::numeric AS err,
    (m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Faces')::numeric AS faces,
    (m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Verts')::numeric AS verts,
    (m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Res_Mm')::numeric AS mres,
    (m.mesh_specs->>'Tex_Pix')::numeric AS tex,
    (m.mesh_specs->>'Geom_Delta_Mm')::numeric AS geom
  FROM scans s
  JOIN pointcloud p ON p.arcref = s.arcref AND p.crewref = s.crewref
  JOIN registration r ON r.arcref = s.arcref AND r.crewref = s.crewref
  JOIN mesh m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneref
), c1 AS (
  SELECT *,
    log(10, res*1000) / log(10, pd) * 5 AS sri,
    cov * (1 + lap/100 * (1 - cov/100)) AS sce,
    faces / (verts * power(mres, 2)) * 1000 AS mcr,
    tex / (sqrt(faces) * mres) * 0.01 AS tdi,
    res / (acc * sqrt(1 + err/acc)) AS rar
  FROM base
), c2 AS (
  SELECT *,
    power(10/sri, 1.5) * (sce/100) * power(1 - noise/30, 2) AS sqs,
    mcr * (tdi/10) * (1 + exp(-geom)) AS mfs
  FROM c1
), c3 AS (
  SELECT *, sqs*0.4 + mfs*0.4 + sce*0.2 - 5*sqrt(noise/10) AS adc FROM c2
)
SELECT si.zoneregistry AS site_code, si.zonelabel AS site_name,
  ROUND(AVG(0.3*adc + 0.3*mfs + 0.2*rar + 0.2*sce - 2*sqrt(err/res)), 2) AS dpq
FROM c3 JOIN sites si ON si.zoneregistry = c3.zoneref
GROUP BY si.zoneregistry, si.zonelabel
ORDER BY dpq DESC

WITH b AS (
  SELECT si.zoneregistry,
    (p.cloud_metrics->>'Total_Pts')::numeric AS tp,
    (p.cloud_metrics->>'Cloud_Dense')::numeric AS cd,
    (sp.spatial_dims->>'Area_M2')::numeric AS area,
    (f.feature_analysis->>'Trait_Count')::numeric AS traits,
    (f.feature_analysis->>'Arti_Count')::numeric AS artis
  FROM sites si
  LEFT JOIN scans s ON s.zoneref = si.zoneregistry
  LEFT JOIN pointcloud p ON p.arcref = s.arcref AND p.crewref = s.crewref
  LEFT JOIN spatial sp ON sp.arcref = s.arcref AND sp.crewref = s.crewref
  LEFT JOIN features f ON f.zoneref = si.zoneregistry
), c AS (
  SELECT *, tp / NULLIF(cd * area, 0) AS pcdr FROM b
)
SELECT zoneregistry AS site_code,
  ROUND(AVG(pcdr), 2) AS avg_pcdr,
  ROUND(AVG((traits + artis) / NULLIF(pcdr * sqrt(cd), 0) * 1000), 2) AS avg_fee
FROM c
GROUP BY zoneregistry
ORDER BY avg_fee DESC NULLS LAST

WITH b AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN pr.flowsoft ~* '^(agi|agisoft|agisoft metashape|metashape)\.?$' THEN 'Agisoft'
      WHEN pr.flowsoft ~* '^(cc|c\.c\.|cloud ?compare)$' THEN 'CloudCompare'
      WHEN pr.flowsoft ~* '^(geo|geo\.|geomagic|geomagic studio)$' THEN 'Geomagic'
      WHEN pr.flowsoft ~* '^(rc|r\.c\.|reality ?capture)$' THEN 'RealityCapture'
      ELSE pr.flowsoft
    END AS software,
    pr.flowstage AS stage,
    (pr.system_usage->>'Flow_Hrs')::numeric AS hrs,
    (pr.system_usage->>'Proc_CPU')::numeric AS cpu,
    (pr.system_usage->>'Proc_GPU')::numeric AS gpu,
    split_part(s.size, ' ', 1)::numeric AS gb,
    (p.cloud_metrics->>'Total_Pts')::numeric AS tp
  FROM processing pr
  JOIN scans s ON s.zoneref = pr.zoneref
  JOIN pointcloud p ON p.arcref = s.arcref AND p.crewref = s.crewref
), c AS (
  SELECT *, gb * log(10, tp) / (hrs * (cpu + gpu) / 200) AS per FROM b
), g AS (
  SELECT software, stage,
    AVG(hrs) AS avg_hrs, AVG(cpu) AS avg_cpu, AVG(gpu) AS avg_gpu, AVG(gb) AS avg_gb, AVG(per) AS avg_per,
    COUNT(*) AS workflow_count
  FROM c GROUP BY software, stage
)
SELECT software, stage,
  ROUND(avg_hrs, 1) AS avg_processing_hours,
  ROUND(avg_cpu, 1) AS avg_cpu_usage_pct,
  ROUND(avg_gpu, 1) AS avg_gpu_usage_pct,
  ROUND(avg_gb, 1) AS avg_data_size_gb,
  ROUND(avg_per, 1) AS avg_per,
  CASE WHEN avg_per < 0.5 THEN 'Bottleneck Detected' ELSE 'Efficient' END AS efficiency_status,
  workflow_count
FROM g
ORDER BY CASE WHEN avg_per < 0.5 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, avg_per ASC
note: Software spellings normalized to 4 canonical names; file size comes from scans via the site, total points from pointcloud.

WITH e AS (
  SELECT zoneref,
    (ambient_cond->>'Ambic_Temp')::numeric AS temp,
    (ambient_cond->>'Hume_Pct')::numeric AS hum,
    (ambient_cond->>'Illume_Lux')::numeric AS lux
  FROM environment
), g AS (
  SELECT si.zoneregistry, si.zonelabel,
    AVG(temp) AS avg_temp, AVG(hum) AS avg_hum, AVG(lux) AS avg_lux,
    AVG(100 - 2.5 * abs(temp - 20) - power(abs((hum - 50) / 2), 1.5) - 600 / (lux + 100)) AS avg_esi
  FROM e JOIN sites si ON si.zoneregistry = e.zoneref
  GROUP BY si.zoneregistry, si.zonelabel
)
SELECT zoneregistry AS site_code, zonelabel AS site_name,
  ROUND(avg_temp, 1) AS avg_temperature, ROUND(avg_hum, 1) AS avg_humidity, ROUND(avg_lux, 1) AS avg_illumination,
  ROUND(avg_esi, 1) AS avg_esi,
  NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY avg_esi) AS esi_quartile,
  CASE WHEN avg_esi > 85 THEN 'Optimal Scanning Conditions'
       WHEN avg_esi >= 70 THEN 'Good Scanning Conditions'
       WHEN avg_esi >= 50 THEN 'Acceptable Scanning Conditions'
       ELSE 'Challenging Scanning Conditions' END AS environmental_condition
FROM g
ORDER BY avg_esi DESC

WITH m AS (
  SELECT s.zoneref,
    log(10, ((p.cloud_metrics->>'Scan_Resol_Mm')::numeric)*1000) / log(10, (p.cloud_metrics->>'Point_Dense')::numeric) * 5 AS sri,
    (p.cloud_metrics->>'Cover_Pct')::numeric * (1 + (p.cloud_metrics->>'Lap_Pct')::numeric/100 * (1 - (p.cloud_metrics->>'Cover_Pct')::numeric/100)) AS sce,
    (p.cloud_metrics->>'Noise_Db')::numeric AS noise
  FROM scans s JOIN pointcloud p ON p.arcref = s.arcref AND p.crewref = s.crewref
)
SELECT si.zoneregistry AS site_code, si.zonelabel AS site_name,
  ROUND(AVG(power(10/m.sri, 1.5) * (m.sce/100) * power(1 - m.noise/30, 2)), 2) AS avg_sqs
FROM m JOIN sites si ON si.zoneregistry = m.zoneref
GROUP BY si.zoneregistry, si.zonelabel
ORDER BY avg_sqs DESC

WITH b AS (
  SELECT e.equipregistry,
    (pr.system_usage->>'Flow_Hrs')::numeric AS hrs,
    (pr.system_usage->>'Proc_CPU')::numeric AS cpu,
    (pr.system_usage->>'Proc_GPU')::numeric AS gpu,
    split_part(s.size, ' ', 1)::numeric AS gb,
    (m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Verts')::numeric AS verts
  FROM equipment e
  LEFT JOIN processing pr ON pr.equipref = e.equipregistry
  LEFT JOIN mesh m ON m.zoneref = pr.zoneref AND m.equipref = pr.equipref
  LEFT JOIN scans s ON s.zoneref = pr.zoneref
), c AS (
  SELECT *, hrs * (cpu + gpu) / 2 / NULLIF(gb * 10 * log(10, verts + 10000), 0) AS pru FROM b
), g AS (
  SELECT equipregistry, AVG(pru) AS pru, AVG(hrs) AS avg_hrs, AVG(cpu) AS avg_cpu, AVG(gpu) AS avg_gpu
  FROM c GROUP BY equipregistry
)
SELECT equipregistry AS equipment_id,
  ROUND(pru, 2) AS pru,
  ROUND(avg_hrs, 2) AS avg_processing_hours,
  CASE WHEN pru IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE RANK() OVER (ORDER BY pru ASC NULLS LAST) END AS efficiency_rank,
  CASE WHEN pru IS NULL THEN NULL
       WHEN pru < 5.0 THEN 'Optimized'
       WHEN pru <= 10.0 THEN 'Acceptable'
       ELSE 'Needs Optimization' END AS workflow_status,
  jsonb_build_object('cpu_usage', ROUND(avg_cpu, 2), 'gpu_usage', ROUND(avg_gpu, 2), 'processing_hours', ROUND(avg_hrs, 2)) AS resource_details
FROM g
ORDER BY pru ASC NULLS LAST
note: Averaged per equipment over processing->mesh (zoneref+equipref)->scans (zoneref, for file size). Equipment without data gets NULL PRU, rank and status.
